# CamperRoster: Modern Summer Camp Registration & Management System
> URL: https://camperroster.com
> Contact: hello@camperroster.com | 24/7 AI Voice: +1 (908) 555-0147

## Core Product Capabilities
- **Camper 5-Step Registration**: Progressive, autosaved enrollment with health history, severe allergy triage, 2-sided insurance uploads, buddy matching, and 3-month installment plans.
- **Volunteer & Staff Pipeline**: Counselor applications with automated KaiCalls voice phone reference verification calls.
- **Director Command Center**: Live enrollment rosters, capacity tracking, and priority triage queues with slide-over medical approval drawers.
- **Nurse Station eMAR**: Daily medication administration scheduling (breakfast, lunch, dinner, bedtime) with 1-tap PIN logging and offline caching.
- **Cashless Canteen POS**: Camper barcode scanner, daily allowance limits, and instant wallet balance debiting.
- **Model Context Protocol (MCP)**: Native `@camperroster/mcp-server` integration for AI agents.
